prefix_population.selection_rule: sort eligible (seed,class,step149) tuples by SHA256(salt|seed|class|step), greedily accept only if the class quota is open and the global seed is unused; class795 is the only confirmatory stratum because the motivating posthoc effect was concentrated there, while classes207/602 are gross-harm sentinels
selection_must_not_read: FID, Inception, DINO, CLIP, or any external embedding
prefix_population.exclusion_rule: exclude an exact (global_seed,class_id,step149) tuple if an earlier DiT-v2.2 suffix manifest already consumed it; exclusions are collision control, not quality filtering

fresh_rng.derivation: first 63 bits of SHA256(namespace NUL trace_identity NUL global_seed NUL rollback_step NUL target_slot NUL attempt_index)
preflight: all 512 new fresh stream seeds must be unique
their set must be disjoint from every fresh stream seed recorded by earlier DiT-v2.2 suffix manifests
the generated runner source must contain the frozen new namespace

internal_selector.primary_horizon_timing: index 0 is the common prediction before the first fresh step149 innovation; index 10 is the prediction after exactly ten fresh P transitions
internal_selector.anonymous_slot_rule: map physical attempts 1..4 to anonymous slots A..D by a frozen per-prefix SHA256 permutation before computing any tie break or external mapping
internal_selector.equal_compute_control: one of the same four scouts selected by a frozen uniform hash independent of arrays and images
internal_selector.tie_break: smallest anonymous slot under the frozen per-prefix permutation, never physical attempt index or endpoint quality
internal_selector.important_interpretation: A_m is a relative branch-geometry rank, not a probability of image quality and not an anytime-valid p-value

external_judge_only.primary_population: the 96 frozen class795 prefixes; no posthoc bad-prefix filter
external_judge_only.blind_defect_scale: 0=ordinary for this frozen model, 1=obviously below the model's ordinary level because of blur/fusion/misalignment, 2=severe or catastrophic clear-bad; do not penalize mild ordinary model imperfections
external_judge_only.primary_comparison: blind absolute defect severity of max-A versus the exact uniform-random policy value over the same four already-computed scouts
external_judge_only.primary_estimand: D_i=mean_m L_im-L_i,max on class795, where L is consensus defect severity divided by two; positive is better
external_judge_only.primary_test: within-prefix branch-label randomization, at least 1000000 permutations with a frozen seed, one-sided alpha 0.05, plus prefix bootstrap 95% interval
secondary_comparisons: a frozen realized hash-random slot for win/tie/loss intuition only
repair of blur, fusion, topology, limb/object attachment, or displacement when attempt0 is independently judged a clear opportunity
safety: new severe blur, fusion, topology, limb/object attachment, displacement, count, pose, or composition error
harm among prefixes whose attempt0 is not clear-bad
external_judge_only.judges: three fresh isolated blind reviewers after frozen anchor qualification; consensus and each reviewer reported
external_judge_only.reliability_gate: anchor accuracy at least 80 percent per reviewer, at least 95 percent valid votes, and weighted kappa at least 0.3; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
external_judge_only.allowed_external_secondary_metrics: FID/Inception/DINO/CLIP may be reported only after sealing and may never select a branch, prefix, threshold, or horizon

promote_candidate_only_if: class795 mean D is at least 0.10 normalized severity
the frozen one-sided primary test is <=0.05 and the prefix-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound is above zero
the effect is not solely an attempt-index artifact
clear-bad and semantic-preservation one-sided 95 percent safety bounds stay within a 5 percentage-point noninferiority margin
decision_rule.transfer_boundary: classes207 and 602 have only 16 prefixes each and are gross-harm sentinels, not powered benefit confirmations; no generic three-class claim is allowed
decision_rule.failure_action: stop h10 max-nonconformity in this concrete form; do not rescue it by switching to low-O, another horizon, a class slice, or an external score on the same pool

claim_boundary: The earlier medoid/high-O rule failed and is not part of this candidate.
The earlier h10 max-A result was posthoc and only motivated this test.
This experiment tests branch selection, not a pure internal trigger deciding which prefixes need intervention.
Even a positive result does not establish a consensus-trap law, an anytime-valid quality guarantee, or generalization beyond this frozen sampler and class design.
